name: Payment Migration Timeline
content: Payment migration timeline. Phase 1 schema migration (PAY-101): in progress. Phase 2 backfill (PAY-104): not started. Cutover: ORIGINAL 2026-10-15, REVISED 2026-11-05. Revision reason: PAY-102 schema incompatibility and PAY-103 authentication timeouts in staging validation.

name: Payment Migration Risk Assessment
content: Top risks for the payment migration: 1) schema incompatibility on nullable columns (PAY-102), severity high, blocks cutover. 2) authentication validation latency (PAY-103), severity high, p99 4.2s. 3) historical backfill duration, severity medium, estimated 14 hours. Residual risk after mitigation: medium.

name: Payment Schema Mapping Worksheet
content: Column mapping legacy Oracle to PostgreSQL. 12 columns flagged for nullable mismatch. 4 columns require type coercion. 3 columns require a default value during backfill.

name: Payment Migration Rollback Plan
content: Rollback plan for the payment migration cutover. Step 1: stop the dual-stack writer. Step 2: revert the application config flag. Step 3: replay the last 60 minutes of writes from the PostgreSQL change log. Aligns with runbook CONF-PAY-002 v4. Execution window follows the revised cutover date 2026-11-05. This file carries no direct permissions and relies on folder inheritance.

name: Merchant Payment Gateway Onboarding Guide
content: Merchant onboarding guide for the payment gateway. Covers KYC document requirements, sandbox credential provisioning, test transaction flows and the merchant go-live checklist. This is merchant onboarding documentation, not the platform migration tracked in PAY-101. No direct file permissions; access is inherited from the folder.

name: Authentication Upgrade Design Doc
content: Design for the OAuth 2.1 upgrade (AUTH-201). Short-lived JWTs replace legacy session tokens. Feature flag auth-v2 gates the new validation path. Downstream consumers include the payment staging environment (see PAY-103).

name: Auth Service Load Test Results
content: Load test run for AUTH-204 at 3x peak traffic. OAuth 2.1 validation path: p99 640ms, target met. Legacy session path: p99 4.2s, fails the target and matches the PAY-103 observation.

name: Legacy Auth Troubleshooting Guide
content: Troubleshooting guide for the legacy authentication stack: token expiry errors, clock skew between services, and session store replication lag. Historical reference only. The current upgrade is AUTH-201; this guide is not related to the payment staging validation timeouts tracked in PAY-103. No direct file permissions; access is inherited from the folder.

name: Q3 Security Incident Report
content: Incident INC-2026-Q3-01. Privilege escalation via a stale service account with cluster-admin in staging. Detected 2026-09-11T22:40Z, contained 2026-09-12T02:10Z. No production data accessed. Follow-ups: SEC-004, SEC-005, SEC-006.

name: Privileged Access Audit Log Export
content: Q3 export of privileged bindings. 3 stale bindings found, 2 revoked, 1 pending vendor confirmation. External contractor account (u007) holds read-only staging access only and was not implicated.

name: Q4 Budget Forecast
content: Q4 2026 forecast. Infrastructure: increased for the authentication upgrade (AUTH-201). Payment migration infrastructure: 40k moved from Q4 to Q1 2027 because cutover moved to 2026-11-05. Vendor spend restated by category for compliance.

name: Q3 Business Review Deck
content: Q3 2026 business review deck: revenue, pipeline and headcount summary, plus the Q3 operating metrics. The Q3 security incident is out of scope for this review and is handled separately by the security team. No direct file permissions; access is inherited from the folder.

content: Compensation planning workbook for 2027. Salary bands, bonus pool modeling and equity refresh scenarios. Restricted to the finance team: inherited folder permissions are intentionally not applied to this file, so only the direct permissions below grant access.
